constraints.Phi1II: (1/kappa^2) sqrt(g) G(R); for the flat audit take G'(0)=1 and choose the constant term so the flat background obeys G(0)=0
constraints.Phi2II_flat_linear_part: c_lambda nabla^2 pi with c_lambda=(1-lambda)/(D*lambda-1); curvature-times-momentum terms vanish to first order about R_ij=0, pi^ij=0

source_lock.linear_F_limit: F'(A)=1 (equivalently F(x)=x after auxiliary-field reduction), whose remaining Hamiltonian structure is identified with non-relativistic covariant/projectable HMT Hořava-Lifshitz gravity
source_lock.reference: J. Kluson, Hamiltonian Analysis of U(1) Invariant F(R) Horava-Lifshitz Gravity, arXiv:1012.0473
